title: Few-Step Streaming Video Generation via Condition Shifting
abstract: arXiv:2611.14033v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Few-step sampling reduces the cost of streaming video generation. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) supervises few-step generators with a separate fake-score network, which adds training memory and computation and must track the evolving generator. We extend APEX to streaming video by using condition shifting to estimate the velocity field of the generated distribution within the generator. The original text condition selects generation, while a shifted condition selects fake estimation using the same parameters. This removes the independent fake network while retaining S2-Avatar's frozen reference teacher, Self-Replay Forcing, and perceptual regularization. We evaluate APEX on 180-second videos using three backbone evaluations per block and a one-step spatial Refiner, with a 70-case human study and a 320-case StreamAV-Bench comparison. Compared with S2-Avatar, APEX achieves higher video instruction fulfillment on the Progressiv

translated_title: 基于条件偏移的少步流式视频生成
translated_abstract: 少步采样降低了流式视频生成的成本。分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）需要一个独立的伪造分数网络来监督少步生成器，这会增加训练内存和计算开销，并且必须追踪不断演化的生成器。我们通过条件偏移机制在生成器内部估计生成分布的速度场，将APEX扩展到流式视频生成。原始文本条件用于选择生成，而偏移后的条件在相同参数下选择伪造估计。这移除了独立的伪造网络，同时保留了S2-Avatar的冻结参考教师、Self-Replay Forcing和感知正则化。我们在180秒视频上评估APEX，每个块使用三次骨干评估和一步空间细化器，并进行了70例人类研究和320例StreamAV-Bench对比。与S2-Avatar相比，APEX在Progressiv（原文截断）上实现了更高的视频指令遵循度。
tldr: APEX通过条件偏移机制在生成器内部复用同一参数估计伪造分数，移除了DMD所需的独立伪造网络，同时保留冻结教师与自回放强制等机制，实现了更高效的少步流式视频生成。
en_tdlr: APEX employs condition shifting to estimate the fake score within the generator using shared parameters, eliminating the separate fake network required by DMD while retaining the frozen teacher and Self-Replay Forcing, thereby enabling efficient few-step streaming video generation.
